direction: Hyperrealistic advertising product photograph for a premium espresso bar menu. Square 1:1 frame, product centered and filling about 60% of the frame, camera at a three-quarter angle slightly above the subject, same scale and perspective for every product. Soft diffused studio key light from the left, gentle fill, subtle soft shadow. Seamless warm neutral background in beige and cream with a soft gradient, matte light stone surface. Minimalist composition, realistic textures, appetizing. No text, no logos, no brands, no people, no faces, no hands, no props or decorations beyond what is described.
